# prisma-class-generator

> A Prisma generator that reads schema.prisma via Prisma's DMMF and emits one TypeScript class
> per model, decorated for @nestjs/swagger, class-validator, and/or TypeGraphQL. Runs as an
> additional `generator` block during `prisma generate` — not a library you import at runtime.

Use this when you need NestJS-friendly DTO/entity classes (Swagger schema, class-validator
input validation, GraphQL object types) that stay in sync with schema.prisma as the single
source of truth, without writing them by hand or committing to a full CRUD/DTO-generation
framework.

Verified against Prisma 5, 6, and 7 (both the `prisma-client-js` and `prisma-client` client
generators), and against PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Server, SQLite, and CockroachDB.

## Docs

- [README.md](./README.md): install, configuration options, generated-output examples, a
  comparison with similar generators, and the FAQ (notably: this is not a CRUD generator).
- [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md): architecture and internals, for anyone (human or AI agent)
  modifying this repo rather than just using the published package.

## Notes for coding agents

- The published package is invoked by Prisma's CLI, not imported — point an agent at the
  `generator prismaClassGenerator { provider = "prisma-class-generator" ... }` block in the
  target project's schema.prisma, not at this repo, unless the task is to modify the generator
  itself.
- Options are set in that generator block as strings (Prisma generator config values are
  always strings, e.g. `useValidation = "true"`), not as JS booleans.
